Examples.Title: Update author details
Examples.Description: Update the details of a specific author
Examples.Code:
### Update author details
# @name author-openUpdate
PUT {{host}}/authors/{{id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Project-Id: {{Project-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "manual_trust_level": 2,
  "metadata": {
    "identity_verified": true
  }
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid input data
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Authorization not provided
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Insufficient access
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found
# Content-Type: application/json
# 429
# Description: Too many requests. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal server error
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Send feedback
Examples.Description: Sends a feature request, bug report or other feedback to the Moderation API team. The team reads every request and can reply by email. Limited to 5 requests per minute per organization.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Resolve queue items
Examples.Description: Mark up to 100 items of a queue as resolved in one request. Each item is resolved the same as with `POST /queue/{id}/items/{itemId}/resolve`. IDs that do not exist in the project are skipped and returned in `notFoundIds`.
Examples.Code:
### Resolve queue items
# @name resolveQueueItems
POST {{host}}/queue/{{id}}/items/resolve
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Project-Id: {{Project-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "itemIds": [
    "clx8k2v0e000108l4a9bz3f7q",
    "clx8k2v0e000208l4h2mc6d1r"
  ]
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid input data
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Authorization not provided

Examples.Title: Add words to wordlist
Examples.Description: Add words to an existing wordlist
Examples.Code:
### Add words to wordlist
# @name wordlist-addWords
POST {{host}}/wordlist/{{id}}/words
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Project-Id: {{Project-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "words": [
    "free money",
    "click here"
  ]
}

# Description: Words successfully added to wordlist
